key_insight: Covalently welding aligned 2D polyaramid sheets creates a polymer network that combines high stiffness and strength with exceptional impact toughness.
engineering_relevance: This architecture could enable lightweight protective and barrier materials by improving load transfer between molecular sheets.
method: Pre-graft flexible linkers at sheet peripheries.
Covalently weld sheets in the solid state to promote intersheet load sharing and energy dissipation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a modulus of 69.8 GPa and strength of 3.9 GPa, rivaling Kevlar 29 fibers, with impact toughness up to an order of magnitude beyond Kevlar composites.
watch_item: Scalable fabrication and reproducibility of sheet alignment and intersheet welding remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Covalent Welding of Two-Dimensional Molecular Sheets into Ultra-Stiff, Super-Tough Polymeric Networks
